outcome: Phase 2 of the latency plan: the remaining second of a save and the regular 1.0 s pauses are attributed with permanent debug-level instrumentation. Every pause over half a second in the idle house and in the edit cycles was a CPython generation-2 garbage collection of about 0.82 to 0.94 s ending inside it. A save's evaluation (median 1.59 s) splits into discovery 0.46 s, the catalog block 0.81 s (re-reporting every candidate row after a rule change and rebuilding the static inventory), engine 0.15 s, policy 0.11 s and the rest 0.07 s. In the steady state the runtime refreshes 2.5 times a minute, discovers once a minute at 0.47 s, saves 2.5 times a minute at 0.15 s per snapshot, and full collections run 0.4 times a minute; right after startup they ran every 3 to 4 seconds for a minute.
plan: Homeostatic save and refresh latency investigation plan, phase 2 (permanent instrumentation to close phase 1 gaps) measured on the installation
